status: frozen before evaluating any formula in this sweep
question: Can one global weak-field response approach fixed galaxy RAR performance for BCG dynamics while also approaching the CLASH NFW-lensing reconstruction within its public diagonal errors?

sample.galaxy_domain: 44 MaNGA BCG last-kinematic-radius acceleration measurements with outcome-blind local stellar-density estimates
sample.cluster_domain: 72 CLASH acceleration points in 20 systems with ACCEPT gas plus Hernquist BCG local density
sample.cluster_target_warning: The CLASH total accelerations are spherical NFW deprojections of lensing summaries. NFW is therefore the construction reference, not an independent zero-residual competitor.
sample.grouping: hold out complete BCG or cluster systems
sample.objective: equal-domain mean of equal-system mean squared log10 acceleration residual

fixed_references.cluster_NFW_reference: the reported g_obs itself; use its public diagonal uncertainty scale rather than claiming an independent NFW residual

diagnostic_surfaces.linear_g_rho: cross-validated linear regression of log10(g_obs/g_bar) on standardized log10(g_bar) and log10(rho)
diagnostic_surfaces.quadratic_g_rho_potential: also add standardized log10(g_bar*r/c^2), its square, and pairwise interactions
diagnostic_surfaces.claim_boundary: These are empirical information-content ceilings, not physical theories.

failure_policy.no_formula_passes_but_flexible_surface_p: derive a new constitutive form from the surface residual structure, then preregister a fresh external validation; do not call this sweep confirmation
failure_policy.flexible_surfaces_also_fail: stop tuning functions of only local g_bar, rho, and g_bar*r; acquire theory-neutral same-system lensing/dynamics plus geometry or nonlocal boundary-condition predictors
failure_policy.any_formula_passes: rerun the survivor on full SPARC rotation curves and independent non-NFW lensing observables before any theory claim

claim_boundary: This is an explicitly exploratory, finite formula family following rejection of CPR0; cross-validation limits but does not remove selection bias.
Similarity to MOND/RAR or Refracted Gravity is reported as prior art, not originality.
No algebraic acceleration fit establishes a relativistic lensing law.
The BCG local density is model-derived and the CLASH total acceleration is NFW-deprojected.
